column1: # Geni relationship path: Johannes Bureus -> Emma Leonhart
# **Dictated by Emma, 2026-08-28**, step by step, and every step checked against
# `reports/derived-family.csv` before it was written here: each name she gave matched the
# person our tree reaches by the relation she named. Two she gave with a shorter name --
# `Per Persson Hagman` is `Per Persson` in the tree, `Christina` is `Christina, Sofia
# **Stored ancestor-first, because the direction is the point.** Her words: *"You understand
# that we are supposed to be building a path from Bergitte to me, not from me to Bergitte?
# That is a pretty significant difference."* The spine takes the first uncreated step, so a
# file stored Emma-first walks outward from her; stored Bureus-first it walks down toward her,
# which is the order she asked for.
# **Why this line needs no ancient half.** Emma: *"As Bureus does not have a well known ancient
# ancestry just directly working this one step by step from him to me is okay."* So unlike the
# Charlemagne line there is nothing above Bureus to reach.
# Already on Wikidata: Johannes Bureus `Q633094`, Magdalena Andersdotter `Q141180409`.
# She believes nobody else on this path has an item.
